proofObligations.description: Generate or bind work-order record from live issue workflow.
Produce executable policy decision fixtures or replay packs for all six decision states.
Generate AgentPlane validation, placement, run, replay, and session artifacts for the dogfood work order.
Emit SourceOS state-integrity binding from a live or simulated runtime report, not a fixture-only static reference.
Run Sherlock trace over indexed OrgGov records from work order to score and learning event.
Render the control room from the indexed cross-repo artifacts.

runtimePromotionCriteria: At least one work order is generated or bound by a live workflow step.
All six policy decision states are exercised with replayable evidence.
AgentPlane produces concrete validation, placement, run, replay, and session artifacts.
SourceOS emits a state-integrity binding from report posture.
Sherlock can trace work order to evidence, outcome, score, and learning event.
Delivery Excellence scorecard is computed from demo evidence rather than hand-entered values.
The demo remains non-secret and does not expose raw prompts, credentials, or private local state.
